status_note: The eleven-line covered projection matches RuleDoubleIn::getOpList and all ten attemptMarking whole-def shapes (three marked arithmetic wholes, six rejected logical/shift/no-flag wholes, one offset-precondition reject). Byte-identical between the locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle and Rugra at the GEN4-SQ-BYTELANE-STRUCT-0001 fix commit.

oracle.instrumentation_policy: Unpatched locked oracle: the fixture drives the production RuleDoubleIn::getOpList/applyOp directly through public APIs; no oracle source is modified.

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; byte addressed
architecture.type_factory: one architecture-owned factory shared by all cases; canonical xunknown1/2/4/8 (no case reads a datatype beyond the rule's own guards)

compiler_spec.calling_convention: empty input/output records; no effects, symbols, or injections

analysis_options.api: Direct production RuleDoubleIn::getOpList once and RuleDoubleIn::applyOp once per case; no ActionPool, no restart, no heritage
analysis_options.funcdata: Fresh synthetic Funcdata and BlockBasic per case; high-level mode disabled
analysis_options.ir: A=register:0x40 and B=register:0x50 two-byte inputs (ZEXT case adds A1=register:0x60 one-byte input); the whole-defining op at ram:0x2000 with a two-byte unique output W; SUBPIECE(W,1) -> one-byte hi at ram:0x2010; SUBPIECE(W,0) -> one-byte lo at ram:0x2020
analysis_options.normalization: None. The emitted projection uses semantic scalar values and exact flag reads; no addresses, ids, or orderings are normalized.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and rule execution are deterministic

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(cases, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.ir: A,B register inputs; INT_ADD(A,B) at ram:0x2000 with 2-byte unique output W; SUBPIECE(W,1)->1B hi at 0x2010; SUBPIECE(W,0)->1B lo at 0x2020
cases.expect: MARK: res=1, hi precisHi, lo precisLo (arithmetic_op, typeop.cc:1171)
REJECT: res=0, no flags (logical_op, typeop.cc:1478) — the read_inode_1 0x156998 byte-lane shape

cases.ir: INT_ZEXT(A1) whole (1-byte input); same SUBPIECE pair
cases.expect: REJECT: res=0 (TypeOpIntZext carries no arithmetic flag, typeop.cc:1115-1119)

cases.ir: INT_ADD whole; rule aimed at the lo SUBPIECE (offset 0 != out size 1)

observation_schema.format: Eleven fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one getOpList record followed by ten case records
observation_schema.rule_result_and_opcode: Exact getOpList count/opcode (SUBPIECE=63) and applyOp return per case
observation_schema.marking_flags: target_precis_hi and sibling_precis_lo read from the production Varnode flag accessors after the single applyOp
observation_schema.op_counts: alive op count per case pins that attemptMarking only sets flags (no restructuring, no op churn)

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: MATCH for all ten cases: the rule target is the hi SUBPIECE's op pointer (lo SUBPIECE for offset_mismatch); flags are read from the target/sibling output varnodes; no varnode is freed by a firing (attemptMarking only sets precisLo/precisHi).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_and_order: MATCH for getOpList's single push and attemptMarking's guard order: typelock check, offset==vn size, offset*2==whole size, whole input/written classification, whole-def arithmetic-or-floating categorization, then the vnLo descendant scan (double.cc:3218-3257).
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: MATCH for alive counts: every case keeps exactly three alive ops (whole def + two SUBPIECEs); no case changes op counts.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: MATCH for the vnLo scan's per-descendant comparisons (CPUI_SUBPIECE, in(1) offset==0, out size==vn size) and the whole-def TypeOp flag test (isArithmeticOp || isFloatingPointOp).

pool_applyrulein_path.scope: direct one-shot attemptMarking path only; the isPrecisLo applyRuleIn restructuring path (double.cc:3267-3278) is not exercised by this fixture
